claims.statement: All database access goes through the db-tools MCP gateway whose fixed 7-stage pipeline in pipeline.ts is the single entry every tool and resource handler calls; agent, policy, and app code are lint-forbidden from importing pg, pg-cursor, or mcp-server internals.

The gateway exposes six tools — list_tables, describe_table, explain_query, run_query, sample_rows, search_semantic_layer — with per-tool scopes in TOOL_SCOPES; sample_rows synthesizes SELECT with n capped at 5 and explain_query never runs ANALYZE.

The gateway exposes semantic://data-dictionary and semantic://metrics resources requiring schema:read, stripping [restricted_pii] sections for principals without data:sensitive and auditing each read.

Bearer tokens resolve via authenticateRequest to a server-built principal with scopes from policies/mcp_clients.yaml using timingSafeEqual, and requireScope enforces each tool scope; HTTP-layer auth rejects before MCP dispatch and pipeline re-authenticates.

Server-side sqlGuard uses pgsql-parser WASM warmed once at boot, allows only a single SelectStmt, denies DDL/DML including CTE-hidden writes plus transaction/DDL/execution tags and denylisted functions, and hands its AST to the policy with no double parse.

ColumnScopePolicy reuses the guard AST to mask sensitive projections, AND row-scope predicates per query level, and fail-close on ambiguous or unresolvable references; explain_query runs EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) on the rewritten SQL.

Execution uses a pooled agent_ro client per call with BEGIN READ ONLY, SET LOCAL statement_timeout 30s, bounded pg-cursor read of maxRows+1 with truncated flag and LIMIT 0 column probe, plus rollback and release in finally.

Every tool and resource call writes exactly one synchronous pino JSONL audit line with runId, principal, tool, masked params, rowCount, duration, allow/deny decision, and piiHits, with SQL literals masked and PII redacted.

Errors use sanitized canonical codes mapping PG SQLSTATEs (57014 to TIMEOUT, read-only to FORBIDDEN_STATEMENT, 22/42 data errors to SQL_EXECUTION_ERROR) with DSN, host, IP, user, path, stack, and PII redaction and 500-char cap.

Operator surfaces are both implemented: apps/api is an Express SSE host with server-side persona-to-principal mapping and resume on the same thread, while apps/web is a Vite plus React chat UI posting to POST /api/ask and POST /api/runs/:runId/resume with runId/threadId validation that imports workspace types only from @shared/contracts and is lint-forbidden from importing DB, agent, policy, MCP server, API, or data code.
Any MCP client with a valid token faces identical server enforcement over stateless per-request StreamableHTTP transport at POST /mcp, so DDL/DML attempts fail independent of agent cooperation.
Gateway boot fails closed on malformed YAML, wrong scopes, duplicate clients, or missing token env vars, resolving tokens from process.env only.
The serving catalog is built at boot from information_schema tables, columns, and key constraints merged with sensitive-column flags, refusing to serve an empty catalog.

search_semantic_layer derives allowRestricted from the data:sensitive scope, delegates to hybrid retrieval, and redacts PII per chunk, using an OpenAI-compatible embedder when EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID and EMBEDDING_API_KEY are configured and otherwise a deterministic 1536-dim fake with a boot warning.

The gateway Express app enforces a 1mb JSON limit, serves GET /healthz as 200 { ok: true }, authenticates POST /mcp before MCP dispatch with 401 on failure, and answers GET /mcp with 405 INVALID_PARAMS directing callers to POST /mcp.

Each authorized POST /mcp builds a fresh McpServer plus StreamableHTTPServerTransport pair with sessionIdGenerator undefined and closes the transport in a finally block, giving stateless per-request semantics because the SDK transport is single-use.

POST /reindex requires a valid Bearer token (401 otherwise) and the admin role (403 SCOPE_DENIED otherwise), then runs the injected reindex hook or indexCorpus with resetSemanticCache and returns index counts, mapping indexer failures to 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

The per-request MCP server registers six tools from TOOL_SPECS with pass-through input schemas so every call reaches executeToolCall (strict schemas still advertised via tools/list), returning JSON-stringified results or isError payloads, plus two text/markdown resources (semantic://data-dictionary and semantic://metrics) whose handlers throw the stringified DbToolError on denial.
The catalog marks both order_items and orders as large tables needing a filter before a full scan.
